race.comment: AIRWAVES (1) looks the most reliable winning option after two narrow defeats in stronger surrounding form, finishing fourth in a Class 2 at Bowen and third in a BM55 at Townsville, each time beaten just over a length. The rise to 1750m is the query, but the class profile and apprentice claim keep him high in calculations. CONVO (2) comes through a provincial BM55 at Townsville, where she was third to Beta Better and bumped near the 300m, and her earlier BM74 run gives the form some depth for this grade. MAYOR OF KINGSTON (5) steps up from picnic company after a fifth at Atherton, yet his Birdsville BM55 second, beaten a head by Hi Frank, reads well enough to make him a genuine threat. KHAMIS (8) has been costly to follow, but her BM65 eighth at Townsville was only beaten three and a half lengths after closing from back in the field, and this is a more suitable assignment if she repeats that finish.
